player_0.content: New plan: I prematurely concluded the exploration by issuing "DONE" while in the Recreation room, failing to check if all available directions from the current and previously visited rooms had been fully explored. Specifically, upon returning to the Billiard room (which had directions south, west, east), I only went west and then immediately returned to the start, ignoring the untried "south" direction from the Billiard room which likely led to unvisited rooms. Next time, I will maintain a strict record of untried directions for every room visited. Before issuing "DONE", I will verify that every room in my `nodes` list has had all its available directions explored. If I am in a room with untried directions, I will take one; if I am in a room with no untried directions but other visited rooms have untried directions, I will navigate back to a room with untried options rather than stopping.
